home_meta_description: Private dog training in Tehran with {name}, {years} years of experience. Basic and advanced obedience, behavior modification, specialist training and competition prep, for every breed and age. The first evaluation is free.
home_hero_title_words: : sit, stay, come to you, keep calm and walk at heel
home_hero_line_two: at your place or at the center.
home_hero_bubble: Hi, I'm Zurvann! Come on in, the door's open.
home_step_request_detail: Tell us about your dog. Add a photo or a short video if you like.
home_step_call_detail: You pick a time together, and {trainer} meets your dog in person.
home_step_open_detail: Your account shows which courses are open to your dog.
home_step_train_detail: Once you've paid, {trainer} calls you and you plan the sessions together.
home_teach_intro: {trainer} works with every breed, at any age. These are the five things she does.
home_service_basic_detail: Everyday obedience, for puppies and grown dogs.
home_service_basic_point_one: Name, sit, stand, down, stay, come and heel.
home_service_basic_point_two: Advanced level: long stays, and listening to commands away from home.
home_service_basic_point_three: You can start from two months old.
home_service_behavior_detail: For when one of your dog's habits is making life hard for you.
home_service_behavior_point_one: Aggression, biting, separation anxiety, toilet accidents and scavenging.
home_service_behavior_point_two: First we find out why your dog does it, then we work on the behavior itself.
home_service_specialist_detail: For dogs with a job to do: guarding, tracking, protection and sport.
home_service_specialist_point_one: Property guard, bodyguard, service dog and alert dog.
home_service_specialist_point_two: Tracking: search and rescue, and detection.
home_service_specialist_point_three: Each dog's program is planned after the evaluation.
home_service_competition_title: Preparing for national and international competitions
home_service_competition_detail: For when you want to take your dog to a competition.
home_service_competition_point_one: Preparation for the BH, IGP 1 to 3, FH and WUSV trials.
home_service_competition_point_two: Regular tracking, obedience and protection practice right up to competition day.
home_service_competition_says:
Sit up straight?
The judge is watching!
home_service_advice_title: Expert advice before and after training
home_service_advice_detail: Ask {trainer} your questions before you start and after the training ends.
home_service_advice_point_one: Before you start: which course, and what for.
home_service_advice_point_two: After training: how to keep the practice going at home.
home_service_advice_point_three: The first step is the free evaluation.
home_formats_line: Whichever suits you, arrange it with {trainer}.
home_format_home_detail: {trainer} comes to you, wherever you are in Tehran.
home_format_center_detail: You bring your dog to the center, and the sessions are held there.
home_format_boarding_title: Boarding with training, by prior arrangement
home_format_boarding_detail: For now with a partner kennel: your dog stays there for a while and is trained there.
home_trainer_hanging_bubble: I can see everything from up here!
home_trainer_line: The person who evaluates your dog is the one who trains it.
